script.title: THE PLANT SHOP
script.story_hook: A dark apartment, an orange cat, one careful plant shopper.
script.intro_zh: 採光差的公寓、一隻橘貓，一位認真的買花人。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's plant shop visit. Listen for describing your space.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今天的植物店。留意描述居住環境的說法。
script.outro: The right plant, the right price, the right cat. Listen once more and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 選對植物、對價，也對了那隻貓。再聽一遍，跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's time to say each line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在輪到我們逐句跟讀了。
script.title_quote: Mango Eats Every Green Thing I Own
script.char_a_description: a cheerful grad student in her twenties with warm brown hair in a low ponytail, round wire glasses, a denim jacket over a striped long-sleeve shirt, small canvas tote, clean sneakers, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a gentle shopkeeper in his sixties with thinning white hair, a tidy grey mustache, kind smiling eyes, a tan linen shirt under a moss green cardigan, reading glasses on a cord, and a slight stooped build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm on a serious houseplant mission today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ɑn ə ˈsɪɹiəs ˈhaʊsˌplænt ˈmɪʃən təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我今天肩負一項認真的大任：挑盆室內植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I love a mission. Tell me more.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ lʌv ə ˈmɪʃən tɛl mi mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我最喜歡帶任務上門的客人。多說一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My apartment gets almost no sunlight, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ əˈpɑɹtmənt ɡɛts ˈɔlmoʊst noʊ ˈsʌnˌlaɪt ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 我家幾乎曬不到太陽，嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: North-facing windows? That's the classic plant killer.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɔɹθ ˈfeɪsɪŋ ˈwɪnˌdoʊz ðæts ðə ˈklæsɪk plænt ˈkɪləɹ/
dialogue.zh: 窗戶朝北？那可是經典的植物墳場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two of them, and my desk is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʌv ðɛm ænd maɪ dɛsk ɪz dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 有兩面朝北，書桌旁更是暗暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, some plants love living in shadows.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈwɝi səm plænts lʌv ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ˈʃæˌdoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，有些植物天生愛住在影子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that's the most encouraging thing I've heard.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ðə moʊst ɪnˈkɝɪdʒɪŋ θɪŋ aɪv hɝd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這是我聽過最鼓舞人心的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's true! What about pets? Any cats?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tɹuː wʌt əˈbaʊt pɛts ˈɛni kæts/
dialogue.zh: 真的！家裡有寵物嗎？有貓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one enormous orange cat, named Mango.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ɪˈnɔɹməs ˈɔɹɪndʒ kæt neɪmd ˈmæŋˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有，一隻超大橘貓，名叫芒果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must pick pet-safe leaves only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi məst pɪk pɛt-sæf livz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 那我們只能挑對寵物安全的葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, not all plants are safe for cats?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ nɑt ɔl plænts ɑɹ seɪs fɚ kæts/
dialogue.zh: 噢，不是所有植物對貓都安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sadly no, lilies especially, they're very bad news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslædli noʊ ˈlɪliz ɪˈspɛʃəli ðɛrz ˈvɛɹi bæd nuz/
dialogue.zh: 很可惜，百合之類特別危險，千萬別碰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know! So, safe and shady?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ soʊ seɪf ænd ˈʃeɪdi/
dialogue.zh: 學到了！所以，安全又不挑光線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our dream customer right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈaʊɚ dɹim ˈkʌstəməɹ ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您就是我們夢寐以求的那種客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me your shadow-approved, cat-approved options.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi jɔɹ ˈʃæˌdoʊ-əˈpɹugd kæd-əˈpɹʌgd ˈɑpʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 請給我看陰影認證、貓咪認證的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First: the snake plant, tough as a rock.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst ðə sneɪk plænt tʌf æz ə ɹɑk/
dialogue.zh: 第一：虎尾蘭，硬朗得像石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is a snake plant... actually dangerous?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪz ə sneɪk plænt ˈæktʃuəli ˈdeɪndʝɚəs/
dialogue.zh: 等等，虎尾蘭其實……對貓有毒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To cats, yes, mildly. Let's cross it off.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə kæts jɛs ˈmaɪdli lɛts kɹɑs ɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 對貓是有輕微毒性，我們把它劃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crossed off! My cat has zero judgment.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɹɔst ɑf maɪ kæt hæz ˈzɪɹoʊ ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/
dialogue.zh: 劃掉！我家貓對什麼都敢下嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second: the spider plant, super fun to look at.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd ðə ˈspaɪdɚ plænt ˈsupɚ fʌn tə lʊk æt/
dialogue.zh: 第二：吊蘭，長相超級有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one with the little dangling babies?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn wɪð ðə ˈlɪɾəl ˈdæŋɡlɪŋ ˈbeɪbiz/
dialogue.zh: 就是垂著好多小植株的那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Totally cat-safe, and nearly impossible to kill.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtoʊɾəli kæt-seɪf ænd ˈnɪɹli ɪmˈpɑsəbl tə kɪl/
dialogue.zh: 對！完全對貓安全，而且幾乎養不死。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Babies hanging off a plant is honestly great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪbiz ˈhæŋɪŋ ɔf ə plænt ɪz ˈɑnəstli ɡɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽植物掛著小寶寶，老實說太療癒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third, my favorite: the pothos, a trailing vine.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɝd maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt ðə ˈpoʊθɑs ə ˈtɹeɪlɪŋ vaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 第三，我的最愛：綠蘿，會垂下來的藤蔓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, is the pothos safe for Mango too?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ɪz ðə ˈpoʊθɑs seɪf fɚ ˈmæŋˈɡoʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，綠蘿對芒果也安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, pothos bugs cats a little, so skip it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli ˈpoʊθɑs bʌɡz kæts ə ˈlɪɾəl soʊ skɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 其實綠蘿會讓貓有點興奮發狂，跳過它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, spider plant it is... um, one problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈspaɪdɚ plænt ɪt ɪz ʌm wʌn ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 好，就吊蘭了……嗯，可是有個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's up? You look like you're remembering something.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ʌp ju lʊk laɪk jʊɹ ɹɪˈmɛmbɚɹɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？你一副剛剛想起什麼的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mango eats every green thing I own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmæŋˈɡoʊ its ˈɛvɹi ɡɹin θɪŋ aɪ ˈoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 芒果會吃掉我所有綠綠的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh. Then even safe leaves won't survive him.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn ˈivən seɪf livz woʊnt sɚˈvaɪv hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 噢。那再安全的葉子也撐不過牠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, I need cat-proof, not just cat-safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ nid kæt-pɹuːf nɑt dʒʌst kæt-seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 就是！我要貓拿它沒辦法的，不只是安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you're talking my language: the cast-iron plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ jʊɹ ˈtɔkɪŋ maɪ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ðə kæst-ˈaɪɚn plænt/
dialogue.zh: 這就聊進我的專業了：鑄鐵草。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cast iron? Can I water metal?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæst ˈaɪɚn kən aɪ ˈwɔɾɚ ˈmɛɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 鑄鐵？鐵還用澆水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! It's just its nickname for being unkillable.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪts dʒʌst ɪts ˈnɪkˌneɪm fɚ ˈbiɪŋ ʌnˈkiləbəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這是牠「養不死」的外號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unkillable is a bold claim in this store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈkiləbəl ɪz ə boʊld kleɪm ɪn ðɪs stɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 養不死？在你這種店裡算大話喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's not a claim, it's a warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts nɑt ə kleɪm ɪts ə ˈwɔɹənti/
dialogue.zh: 這不是大話，這是保固。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, you guarantee houseplants?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ju ˌɡæɹənˈti ˈhaʊsˌplænts/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你們還保固室內植物？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty days, replace it free if it fades.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝɾi ˈdeɪz ɹɪˈpleɪs ɪt fɹi ɪf ɪt feɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 三十天內枯萎，免費換一盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, unkillable plus a warranty, I'm impressed.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌnˈkiləbəl plʌs ə ˈwɔɹənti aɪm ɪmˈpɹɛst/
dialogue.zh: 好，養不死又有保固，我服了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, watering truth time: how often do you remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈwɔɾɚɪŋ tɹuːθ taɪm haʊ ˈɔfən du ju ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 來，誠實面對澆水：你記得住多久澆一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... weekly when I'm home, never when I travel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈwikli wɛn aɪm hoʊm ˈnɛvɚ wɛn aɪ ˈtɹævəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……在家每週記得澆，一出遠門就全忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this plant drinks once a month, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs plænt dɹɪŋks wʌns ə mʌnθ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 那這盆一個月喝一次就夠，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once a month? My goldfish needs less care.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ə mʌnθ maɪ ˈɡoʊldˌfɪʃ nidz lɛs kɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 一個月一次？我家金魚都沒這麼省心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low effort, high green. Anything else for the shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ˈɛfɚt haɪ ɡɹin ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls fɚ ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 費力少，綠色多。架子上還想添什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell the cute ceramic pots too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ðə kjuːt səˈɹæmɪk pɑts tu/
dialogue.zh: 你們也賣可愛的陶盆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the gray one chips easier, be warned.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ðə ɡɹeɪ wʌn tʃɪps ˈiziɚ bi wɔɹnd/
dialogue.zh: 有，但灰色那款容易缺角，先提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chips near a cat? Hard pass, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪps nɪɹ ə kæt hɑɹd pæs θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 會缺角又放在貓旁邊？那算了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. The terracotta is sturdy and drains well.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ðə ˌtɛɹəˈkɑɾə ɪz ˈstɝdi ænd dɹeɪnz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。陶盆結實，排水也好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that one in medium, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðæt wʌn ɪn ˈmidiəm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，請幫我拿中號的那盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pot, plant, saucer... that's thirty-eight dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑt plænt ˈsɔɹsɚ ðæts ˈθɝɾi eɪt ˈdɑləz/
dialogue.zh: 盆、植物、底盤……共三十八美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Oh no, did I just knock over the fern?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt oʊ noʊ dɪd aɪ dʒʌst nɑk ˈoʊvɚ ðə fɝn/
dialogue.zh: 完美。噢不，我剛剛是不是撞倒了那盆蕨類？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! He was top-heavy, happens all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hi wəz ˈtɑpˈhɛvi ˈhæpənz ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！牠頭重腳輕，這種事天天發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry, is everything okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm soʊ ˈsɑɹi ɪz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太對不起了，都沒事吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a leaf harmed, truly, we're both fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə lif hɑɹmd ˈtɹuːli wɪɹ boʊθ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 一片葉子都沒傷到，真的，我和牠都好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your calm is making me feel better.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ kɑm ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ mi fil ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你的冷靜讓我的心跳平復了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plants forgive people, it's their superpower.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænts fɚˈɡɪv ˈpipəl ɪts ðɛɹ ˈsupɚˌpaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 植物原諒人類，這是牠們的超能力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mango will not forgive the spider plant, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmæŋˈɡoʊ wɪl nɑt fɚˈɡɪv ðə ˈspaɪdɚ plænt ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過，芒果可不會放過那盆吊蘭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a shelf up high, he'll adjust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə ʃɛlf ʌp haɪ hil əˈdʒʌst/
dialogue.zh: 把它放到高處的架子，牠會適應的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for all this help, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ɔl ðɪs hɛlp ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 真心感謝你這一路的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go grow something, and wave at Mango for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɡɹoʊ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ænd weɪv æt ˈmæŋˈɡoʊ fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 回去種點什麼吧，替我跟芒果揮揮手。

script.youtube_title: 【植物殺手大翻身🌿】「我家貓吃掉所有綠植😹」低光照・寵物安全・澆水頻率一次搞懂💧｜60句沉浸英文聽力｜Choosing a Houseplant
script.youtube_title_en: "Mango Eats Every Green Thing I Own" — Choosing a Pet-Safe Houseplant
script.youtube_description:
「芒果會吃掉我所有綠綠的東西」——在植物店挑一盆能活下來的室內植物，原來有這麼多學問！這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在滿室綠意的植物小舖。

你會聽到：用英文描述採光、說清屋子的朝向；詢問寵物安全、聽懂虎尾蘭、吊蘭、綠蘿各自的貓貓風險；從養不死的承諾到三十天保固；還有誠實交代澆水頻率、讓店員推薦一個月喝一次水的懶人神物。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，自然出現美國人對話中的 um、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：What about pets?、Let's cross it off、How often do you remember?、That's thirty-eight dollars。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴噹。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Mango eats every green thing I own!" — choosing a houseplant gets complicated when your cat treats the shelf like a buffet. This is a 60-line immersive listening practice inside a leafy little plant shop.

You will hear: describing low light and north-facing windows in English, asking which plants are pet-safe, learning that snake plants, spider plants and pothos each handle cats differently, hearing a bold unkillable claim backed by a thirty-day warranty, and honestly confessing your watering schedule.

Everything stays in A2-level words with natural American fillers: um, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like What about pets?, Let's cross it off, How often do you remember?, and Go grow something.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
公寓採光差、家裡還有一隻見綠就咬的貓，這樣也能養活室內植物嗎？走進植物店，該怎麼開口描述你的家？

這一集帶大家走進一間綠意滿滿的植物小舖，從說明採光、聊寵物安全、比較虎尾蘭吊蘭綠蘿，到聽保固、談澆水習慣、選陶盆，最後還不小心撞倒一盆蕨類，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🌤️ 描述環境：My apartment gets almost no sunlight, um...
🐱 問安全性：Oh, not all plants are safe for cats?
🛡️ 聽保固：Thirty days, replace it free if it fades.
💧 談澆水：Um... weekly when I'm home, never when I travel.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。下次走進任何店裡，這些英文都會自己從嘴邊冒出來。

願你和你的貓，都能和植物和平共處。
